pullRequest.title: fix: assess migration only for confirmed legacy Sessions
pullRequest.body:
## Summary
Current-v2 Sessions automatically queried migration-only authority during compatibility loading and permission metadata updates. Real Bamboo18 acceptance exposed unnecessary 503 reads after an Actor observation became stale, even though canonical execution compatibility still admitted the Session.

Only settled, positively observed legacy-compatible Sessions now trigger automatic assessment and permit a new migration. Operation scope stays mounted for the same Session across loading/current/conflict transitions, preserving the exact pending UUID/CAS/birth witness until receipt and lifetime confirmation finish. Current or unknown Sessions retain an explicit Refresh migration state action for read-only/cold recovery; readiness alone cannot authorize a new operation. No backend rule, HTTP assertion, retry policy, CI, publisher or upstream pin changes. The tool-activity screenshot now blurs its process disclosure directly, avoiding a fixed-coordinate click that could open a tool row after the notice height changed; all collapsed/detail-count/keyboard assertions remain intact.

## Test Plan
- Focused hook/Notice/Action behavior: 36 passed, including subscribed current-v2 before delayed Child lifetime confirmation, current permission refreshes with zero migration GETs, and exact pending/cold/conflict recovery.
- Local full `npm run verify`: 240 files / 4,929 tests passed; type, lint, i18n/theme, architecture, build and package checks passed.
- Desktop/phone migration browsers: all 14 existing cases passed; both new permission-change cases passed after correcting the new fixture's CAS ETag progression and retaining exact If-Match checks. No product change followed the full unit validation.
- Original real Bamboo18 permission acceptance: 1 passed locally, covering desktop and phone, persistent reloads and unchanged strict HTTP assertions; its tested commit8eef144 and this final head have identical three product blobs. This is targeted local regression evidence, not formal npm acceptance.
- Original source CI40366671167 failed on both Node22/24 shard2 in the tool-activity screenshot gesture: the coordinate click opened the fifth tool row before the keyboard check. The original test reproduced locally; the one-line blur correction passes that same complete desktop case with zero retries (2.1s). Product src/public trees and package/build inputs are unchanged from b72c080. Fresh source CI on9446b8d and independent review remain required. Historical failed publishers and frontend27/28 tags/records remain intact; frontend29 publication is a separate producer step.

## Screenshots
[Desktop](https://github.com/bigduu/lotus-next/blob/b72c080c0a4e8f57e38bc8c85c5018a1a7f62e04/docs/screenshots/migration-auto-assessment/current-desktop.png) · [Phone](https://github.com/bigduu/lotus-next/blob/b72c080c0a4e8f57e38bc8c85c5018a1a7f62e04/docs/screenshots/migration-auto-assessment/current-phone.png)

Refs #447; producer tracker #438 and bigduu/Bodhi-AI#116.
